# LILYSILK

> > Premium mulberry silk fashion, bedding, and accessories brand offering luxurious silk clothing and home textiles.

LILYSILK specializes in high-quality silk products ranging from women's apparel to bedding collections. The brand emphasizes premium mulberry silk textiles with seasonal collections like The 2026 Palette and signature items such as the Heirloom '89 Half-Zip Pullover and Silkerry line.

- Mulberry silk products
- Silk clothing and fashion
